cobol_source:
*================================================================*
      * PROGRAM : SORTNAME                                             *
      * PURPOSE : SORT EMPLOYEE FILE ALPHABETICALLY BY NAME            *
      * INPUT   : data/input/employees.dat                             *
      * OUTPUT  : data/output/sorted_by_name.dat                       *
      *================================================================*
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SORTNAME.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT EMP-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/input/employees.dat"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT SORT-FILE ASSIGN TO "sortname.srt".
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/output/sorted_by_name.dat"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  EMP-FILE.
       01  EMP-IN                  PIC X(54).
       SD  SORT-FILE.
           COPY EMPREC.
       FD  OUT-FILE.
       01  EMP-OUT                 PIC X(54).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           SORT SORT-FILE ON ASCENDING KEY EMP-NAME
               USING EMP-FILE
               GIVING OUT-FILE
           DISPLAY "SORTNAME: SORT COMPLETED"
           STOP RUN.

plan.approach: The COBOL SORT verb (USING / GIVING) is decomposed into four discrete steps: (1) fixed-width flat-file parsing into POJOs using EmployeeRecordParser, mirroring USING EMP-FILE; (2) persistence of those POJOs into PostgreSQL via Spring Data JPA's saveAll, replacing the ephemeral SD SORT-FILE work area; (3) a derived-query repository method findAllByOrderByEmpNameAsc() that issues ORDER BY emp_name ASC, faithfully reproducing ON ASCENDING KEY EMP-NAME; and (4) serialisation of the sorted entity list back to a 54-byte fixed-width flat file via EmployeeRecordFormatter, matching GIVING OUT-FILE. Schema management is handled by Flyway (V1__create_employees.sql) with an index on emp_name to support the sort efficiently. CommandLineRunner acts as the program entry point and exits non-zero on failure, mirroring STOP RUN / ABEND behaviour.
patterns_used: Fixed-Width Record Parser / Formatter (Utility classes mirroring COBOL copybook)
plan.sql_strategy: No EXEC SQL blocks existed in the original program. The COBOL SORT verb's in-memory / work-file sort is replaced by a PostgreSQL table (employees) acting as the sort medium. Spring Data JPA's saveAll persists the input records, and a derived query method findAllByOrderByEmpNameAsc() translates to SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY emp_name ASC. A Flyway migration creates the table and a supporting B-tree index on emp_name.
plan.call_strategy: The original program contained no CALL statements. The single behavioural unit (MAIN-PARA) is mapped directly to SortnameService.execute(), which is invoked by SortnameRunner (CommandLineRunner) on application startup.
